summary.text: David Miller is a retired educator and the Democratic candidate for the Tennessee State Senate, District 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He currently holds a seat on the Anderson County school board.

paragraphs.text: David Miller is an officeholder on the Anderson County Schools board, District 8.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he taught for over 35 years, has been president of three local unions, and was elected to the governing board of the Georgia Association of Educators.
In that survey, he listed his key messages as opposition to school vouchers, repealing the state sales tax on groceries, and having corporations pay their fair share of taxes.
